description: CoreForge Meter GPU-cost estimate: total estimated cost for running a GPU type for a number of hours, computed from public cloud GPU list prices, with the cheapest option as the basis plus alternatives. Estimate only, not a quote. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

gpu.description: GPU type, e.g. 'H100', 'RTX 4090', 'L40S' (see meter_gpus for names)

name: meter_estimate
